name: Chalassa
source:
Bloodskin assassin.

Most other species consider the bloodskins an offshoot of the human race, though there is not a single human who wouldn't loudly protest this allegation. Fact is, aside from their home region in the deserts and savannahs, nothing much is known about bloodskins, and Chalassa is no different. She is an enigma: highly skilled in the art of killing, though she doesn't seem to be proud of her talents and almost reluctant to use them.

She definitely has some sort of dark past, thought it is anyone's guess what that may be and whether she has left it behind by now.

Only one thing is for sure: you may not want Chalassa as your ally, but you certainly never want her as your enemy...

[Edited from [url=http://www.winterwolves.net/viewtopic.php?f=40&t=3053]Winter Wolves[/url]]
